metadata.title: Data Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining institutional data, establishing accountability, and setting baseline trust expectations before protection or use.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Institutional data assets including primary data, derived data, metadata, and records across all storage and processing environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern establishing baseline trust assumptions for institutional data independent of applications, integrations, or platforms.

metadata.remarks: Data Core defines the foundational trust properties required to identify what constitutes institutional data and who is responsible for it. This pattern establishes data legitimacy, ownership, scope, and baseline trust assumptions without defining application-level data use or access decisions.

components.title: Data Definition
components.description: Defines what constitutes institutional data, including primary data, derived data, and metadata.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misclassification or omission of institutional data to evade protection requirements.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement establishing authoritative definitions of institutional data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define what constitutes institutional data and associated obligations.

components.title: Data Ownership and Stewardship
components.description: Assigns accountability for data governance, protection, and lifecycle decisions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence of unmanaged data assets due to unclear ownership.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance assigning clear stewardship and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Institutional roles are assigned responsibility for data assets.

components.title: Data Scope and Boundaries
components.description: Defines where institutional data exists and the trust boundaries it crosses.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery and exploitation of data outside assumed trust boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Boundary definition and access controls aligned to data scope.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Trust boundaries for institutional data are defined and enforced.

components.title: Baseline Data Trust Assumptions
components.description: Establishes minimum expectations for data handling and protection across the institution.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of implicit trust in poorly defined data handling assumptions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-defined baseline expectations for data protection.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Baseline trust assumptions for data handling are formally defined.
